title: Admin - Consistent Navigation & Identity Visibility (18 Test Cases)
overview: Functional testing of SCRUM-463: Admin consistent navigation and identity visibility. Validates header displays admin name, role, logout option; left navigation includes all required modules; current section highlighted; role-based access; browser refresh retains page; logout clears session.

testCases.title: Header Displays Admin Role
steps: Verify header shows role (e.g., Super Admin).

testCases.title: Header Displays Logout Option
steps: Verify logout button/link visible in header.

testCases.title: Left Nav Contains Vendor Management Link
steps: Verify 'Vendor Management' link in left nav.

testCases.title: Left Nav Contains Product Management Link
steps: Verify 'Product Management' link in left nav.

testCases.title: Left Nav Contains Comment Moderation Link
steps: Verify 'Comment Moderation' link in left nav.

testCases.title: Left Nav Contains User & Roles Link
steps: Verify 'User & Roles' link in left nav.

testCases.title: Left Nav Contains Content Management Link
steps: Verify 'Content Management' link in left nav.

testCases.title: Current Section is Highlighted in Nav
steps: Verify that nav item is highlighted/active.

testCases.title: Clicking Nav Item Navigates to Correct Module
steps: Verify URL or page content changes.

testCases.title: Logout Clears Session and Redirects to Sign-In
steps: Verify cannot access admin without re-login.

testCases.title: Role-Based Access Hides Restricted Menu Items
steps: Verify nav items match role permissions.

testCases.title: Header Persists Across All Admin Pages
steps: Verify header with name/role visible on each.
